pt-arthur.name: Arthur Vance
pt-arthur.notes: Senior citizen post-stroke requiring soft steamed fish, low purine, and kombu dashi/calamansi umami flavor compensation without salt.

pt-ananya.name: Ananya Vance
pt-ananya.notes: Target fasting insulin < 10 uIU/mL. Strict high-fiber low glycemic grain index (foxtail millet, barley).

bm-1.clinicalSignificance: Upper borderline. Strict table salt and hidden soy sauce restriction mandated.

bm-2.clinicalSignificance: eGFR 48 mL/min indicates CKD Stage 3a. Limit total daily animal protein density.

bm-3.clinicalSignificance: Severe hyperinsulinemia (HOMA-IR 4.2) fueling ovarian androgen synthesis. Zero refined sugars.

m-1.dishName: Steamed Barramundi with Ginger Scallion Dashi & Foxtail Millet
m-1.baseRecipe: Traditional steamed fish fillet with light soy, scallions, and fragrant jasmine rice.
deltaDirectives: Swap white jasmine rice with 100% steamed foxtail millet (GI 54)
Eliminate dark soy sauce; use kombu-shiitake dashi + freshly grated young ginger for umami
Limit cold-pressed sesame oil to strictly 1/2 teaspoon for aroma only
Steam barramundi until fork-tender (Level 5 Minced & Moist for Arthur)
m-1.flavorCompensation: Kombu dashi reduction + splash of calamansi zest provides salinity illusion without added sodium.
m-1.textureGuidance: Flake fillet into small 4mm bite-sized flakes with moist ginger broth.
m-1.dietitianReviewer: Dr. Sarah Chen, APD (Dietitians Association of Australia)
m-1.dietitianNotes: Exceptional low-sodium execution. Safe for Arthur CKD/hypertension and Ananya insulin resistance.

m-2.dishName: Miso-Simmered Silk Tofu & Kabocha Squash in Kelp Broth
m-2.baseRecipe: Simmered tofu with sweet mirin sauce, shoyu, and white sticky rice.
deltaDirectives: Substitute white polished rice with rolled barley & foxtail millet blend
Use white low-sodium koji miso (max 1 tsp) diluted in intense kombu dashi
Simmer kabocha squash until velvet-soft for senior chewing ease
Add finely slivered myoga and yuzu peel for vibrant aromatic lift without salt
m-2.flavorCompensation: Toasted sesame oil mist (1 drop) + yuzu zest mimics rich savoriness without sodium overload.
m-2.textureGuidance: Ultra-tender squash and silky tofu naturally suited for Level 5 swallowing safety.
m-2.dietitianNotes: Verified ultra-low purine and sodium. High soluble fiber promotes gentle glycemic response.

m-3.dishName: Spiced Bitter Gourd (Karela) & Moong Dal with Ragi Roti
m-3.baseRecipe: Fried bitter gourd with tamarind jaggery gravy and white rice.
deltaDirectives: Omit jaggery sugar entirely; utilize roasted cumin and amchur (dry mango powder) for tang
Steam bitter gourd slices lightly before dry-roasting with minimal mustard oil (1/2 tsp)
Pair with split yellow moong dal cooked with turmeric and hing (asafoetida)
Swap refined wheat or rice with high-fiber finger millet (Ragi) soft phulka
m-3.flavorCompensation: Roasted cumin, carom seeds (ajwain), and freshly squeezed lime mask bitterness naturally.
m-3.textureGuidance: Moong dal whisked smooth and warm; soft ragi roti torn into bite-size pieces.
m-3.dietitianNotes: Pending final sodium check on dal tempering.

aud-1.mealName: Steamed Barramundi with Ginger Scallion Dashi
aud-1.oilObservation: Minimal glistening surface, no pooling oil droplets, perfectly steamed finish.
positiveHighlights: Foxtail millet portion strictly controlled under 1 cup cooked volume
Generous ginger shreds boosting digestive comfort and flavor without sodium
Fish is thoroughly moist and easily flaked for senior chewing comfort
aud-1.cookFeedback: Mahusay, Maria! The oil quantity was spot-on and the fish texture is soft and safe for lolo Arthur.
